messages.author: a05cb6d9ea635f30
messages.subject: Error in dataProcess - MSstats suspects that there are fractionations ...
parts:
Hi all,
I came across an error today and I cannot solve the problem.

Standard code:
proteinGroups <- read.table("proteinGroups.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
infile <- read.table("evidence.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
annot <- read.csv("maxquant_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

quant <- MaxQtoMSstatsFormat(evidence=infile, annotation=annot, proteinGroups=proteinGroups)
quantNA <- dataProcess(quant,
                       normalization='equalizeMedians',
                       summaryMethod="TMP",
                       cutoffCensored="minFeature", censoredInt="NA",
                       MBimpute=TRUE,
                       maxQuantileforCensored=0.999)

Error in dataProcess(quant, normalization = "equalizeMedians", summaryMethod = "TMP",  : 
  ** MSstats suspects that there are fractionations and potentially technical replicates too. Please add Fraction column in the input.

My experiment looks like this:
- 3 conditions (WT, KO, SC) 
- 3 replicates per condition
- 2 injections per sample
- the whole experiment repeated twice in different times (biological material was the same, just the extraction and sample preparation so it's just anothe technical repeat)

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Error in dataProcess - MSstats suspects that there are fractionations ...
parts:
Dear Witek,

If I understand correctly, exp1 and exp2 are technical replicates, (not fraction). For example, exp1-KO1_inj-1, exp1-KO1_inj-2, exp2-KO1_inj-1 and exp2-KO1_inj-2 are technical replicates from one biological replicate.

Then, please put only '1' in Fraction column. (Now three values, 1, 2,3 are in Fraction column). If you still have the problem after fixing Fraction column, please let me know.

Hope to help.
- Meena

messages.subject: Re: Error in dataProcess - MSstats suspects that there are fractionations ...
parts:
Dear Witek,

To clarify, what I understand,
1. in the first post : there is no information for fraction column. and you got error. So, you didn't have any summary of sample.
2. in the second post : you add fraction information. there are three values in fraction column. and you got wrong summary of sample and error.

3. What I suggested is that you should add fraction information with only one value. put only '1' in fraction column. 

I hope that I understand correctly so far. Then, I guess that you already tried what I suggested in 3. and still got the wrong summary of sample or error. If yes, it will be easy for me to track where the problem came from with your data on my side. If you can share the data, please send me the email privately.

Hope to help.
- Meena

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Error in dataProcess - MSstats suspects that there are fractionations ...

It was due to missing pattern between technical replicates. Now MSstats can handle it and is available in github and msstats.org as v3.9.2.

- Meena
